Same-artifact row QuantLinear model/state qualification, never a TPS run.

The bounded chunked decode+cuBLAS reference avoids a full FP16 resident shadow.
It is independent of fused projection kernels, not an upstream BF16/corpus oracle.
comparison_scope: Same batch size, prompts and native generation schedule. Cross-batch dense state differences are diagnostic, not matched-implementation evidence.

projection_info.projection_precision_scope: Original per-matrix encoded weights/scales; A16 row codecs decode q*scale with FP16 rounding before FP32 accumulation. int8 explicitly uses one group32 activation Q8 pass; torch.float16 storage/KV, FP32 GDN. q8-residual uses explicit group32 activation high/residual Q8 passes with FP32 scales and changed reduction order; not original FP16 arithmetic.
